name: Risa Inoue
source:
“Yeah? Well, what would you know… You’re just a kid yourself!”

A boisterous, trouble-making student of Misao’s. She harbours an instant dislike of her new teacher seeing her as acting ‘snobby’ and ‘morally superior.’

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=50&t=37532]Lemma Soft Forum[/url]]
